text: The Nominating Panel - Committee of Adjustment will select candidates to be interviewed for appointment by City Council to the Committee of Adjustment. The Nominating Panel will conduct interviews at its next meeting and recommend three candidates to City Council for appointment.

The Nominating Panel - Committee of Adjustment: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview for appointment to the Committee of Adjustment: Candidate COA2-473 Candidate COA2-405 Candidate COA2-494 Candidate COA2-338 Candidate COA2-480 Candidate COA2-468 Candidate COA2-440 Candidate COA2-474 Candidate COA2-481 Candidate COA2-443 Candidate COA2-429 Candidate COA2-398 Candidate COA2-472 Candidate COA2-329 Candidate COA2-321 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (March 12, 2024) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Committee of Adjustment.
